title: Car-accessory seller Bellezza (CS Marketing) says card data of 3,633 people may have leaked
date_note: Date of CS Marketing's announcement as given by ASCII.jp (published the same day).
geo_basis: country only; the page gives no city
summary: ASCII.jp reports that CS Marketing announced on November 24 that unauthorized access to the site of its Bellezza shop may have leaked credit card data of 3,633 people who paid by card from 2018 to 2025. The announcement, as relayed by ASCII.jp, says the cause was unauthorized access exploiting a system vulnerability that tampered with the payment application. A card company raised the concern on June 8, and the firm stopped card payments that day.
plain: A Japanese car-accessory web shop says card details of 3,633 customers may have been leaked after its payment system was tampered with.
exec: Card details of 3,633 people may have been exposed through a tampered payment application, according to the company's announcement.
action: As relayed by ASCII.jp, CS Marketing asks affected customers to check card statements for unfamiliar charges and contact their card company.

evidence.quote: CSマーケティングは11月24日、自動車用シートカバーなどを扱う「ベレッツァ」のサイトに不正アクセスがあり、3633人分のクレジットカード情報が漏えいした可能性があると発表した。

validation.note: Only ASCII.jp (one publisher; the Weekly ASCII copy is the same article) relaying the company's announcement; the company's own notice was not found.

review.note: unsupported fraud tag removed; 3,633, period, cause, date, advice match ASCII.jp
